name: Display & profiles
author: Aaron Sanz Roca
description: Display controls (brightness, warmth, scale, text size) plus a native monitor profile switcher. Selecting a profile rewrites ~/.config/hypr/monitors.lua, enabling/disabling the chosen monitors. Profiles live in ~/.config/omarchy/monitor-profiles/.

barWidget.description: Display controls plus a native monitor profile switcher that edits monitors.lua.
